Description: Raspberry Pi Pico (RP2040), flashed with TMS9918aPiPico.ino.uf2
GAL22V10D-7LPN (or faster), programmed with gal/FPGA_IO.jed: decodes ports 98h/99h, /CSR and /CSW
Octal bus transceiver, slot to Pico (5 V tolerant in, 3.3 V out)
Octal bus transceiver, Pico to slot (3.3 V in, 5 V out) for /WAIT and the reset of the MSX
MSX cartridge edge connector, 50 pins (2 x 25), 2.54 mm pitch, part of the board
Schottky diode, slot +5 V to Pico VSYS
Signal diode, 74HCT245 pulls /WAIT and /RESET of the slot only LOW
Electrolytic capacitor 470 uF 16 V, radial, 3.5 mm pitch, 8 mm diameter (C101 Pico VSYS, C106 +3.3 V)
